events.source_excerpt: UKMTO WARNING 214-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 20 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1500UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM north of Khasab, Oman. A Tanker on an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz has been struck on the port bow by an unknown projectile. The CSO has reported a fire onboard the vessel. No casualties have been reported at this time. No environmental impact reported.

events.qualify_reason: بلاغ رسمي من UKMTO (التحذير 213-26) عن اقتراب قارب مسلح من سفينة بضائع وإطلاق 4 طلقات على 95 ميلًا بحريًا جنوب غرب المكلا (20/11/2026). بلاغ رسمي مباشر لا رواية، فلا يُعد في «روايات لم تتأكد»؛ ولا ضرر مثبت، فلا يُرفع إلى «مؤكدة» (قرار المالك 2026-11-18: النشاط المشبوه لا يُحتسب إصابة مؤكدة).
events.source_excerpt: UKMTO WARNING 213-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 20 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1102UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 95NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen. A Bulk Carrier travelling eastbound in the IRTC was approached on the port side by a dark blue skiff with 6 unidentified, armed persons on board. Four shots were fired in quick succession from the skiff and warning shots were returned by the armed security team onboard the Bulk Carrier.
